content: Obhwiiragaanzi bhwo Omukrisito
Krisito atuheeri obhwiiragaanzi okubha twiikare mubhwiiragaaanzi. Kweego mugumire, mutiikirirya kukyoora kweeki mubhutumwa bhwe emigiro.
Mwiitegeerere kino enye Pauro nikubhabhuurira! Eraabhe muriikirirye okusaarwa kwiiguru yo okugwaata emigiro gya Musa, hayo Krisito atakubha no obhugazuro bhwobhwoosi kweemwe.
Ndabhabhuurira kubhweero kweeki kubha, omusubhe wowoosi wuno ariikirirya kusaarwa, areenderwa okugwaata emigiro gyoosi gya Musa.
Eraabhe muriiseegera kubharwa kubha abhaatu bhe eheene embere wa Taatabhugya kwo okugwaata emigiro, ambe mumenye kubha mwiiyaahwiiri ku Krisito, na mutigiri orubhaango rwa Taatabhugya.
Nawe etwe, kino tukwiisigira kwo obhunagya bhwe Ekoro Muhoreeru ni kubha, Taatabhugya aratubharira kubha abhaatu bhe eheene, kwo okubha turamwiikirirya Yeesu.
Kyeego tugwaateeni na Krisito Yeesu, okusaarwa kasi okutama kusaarwa bhutariho obhugazuro bhwobhwoosi. Obhugazuro ni bhwiikirirya bhweetu bhuno bhukurorekana kwo okuseega abhaandi.
Kubhutaangiro, mwaari murakora bhuzomu! Bhoono ni weewi abharekirye mutagwaata ameegyo go obhuheene?
Obhukorokoombi bhuyo bhutakurwa ku Taatabhugya wuno abhabhirikiiri.
Nawe mumenye kubha, ameegyo go orurimi gayo, ni kya abhaatu bharabhuga, “Ekibhwiisya kisuuhwiigo kiratuunduurya obhutu bhwoosi!”
Nino obhuheene kubha, mutakwiikirirya okungʼeenwa kwo okubha mugwaateeni no Omukuru Yeesu. Nawe omuutu wowoosi naabhe abhe weewi wuno akubhangʼeena, araaza kutemwa.

Abhahiiri bhaane, abhaatu abhaandi bharabhuga, enye nikyaari nirarwaaza kubha abhasubhe bhoosi bhareenderwa bhasaarwe. Kyeego yiingabheeri eheene kubha nirarwaaza ego, kwaki bhoono Abhayahudi bharaninyaakya? Eraabhe niingabheeri nirarwaaza ego, okurwaaza kweenye iguru ya amangʼana go omusaraba gwa Yeesu, kitiingagirirye Abhayahudi bhanibhiihirirye.
Niriigoomba kubha, abhaatu bhano bhakubhabhusa kwa amangʼana go obhusaari, bhaangiizigarya ebho abheene!
Okwiikara kwo obhunagya bhwe Ekoro Muhoreeru

Abhahiiri bhaane, Taatabhugya abhabhirikiiri okubha mubhe abhaatu abhiiragaanzi. Nawe mutakorera obhwiiragaanzi bhweenyu kyeego omweeya gwo okutuniirira enaamba yo omubhiri, nawe musakiranie kwo obhuseegi.
Emigiro gyoosi gya Musa girakumanibhwa hamwe, muusi wo obhuswaagyo bhumwe bhuno bhukubhuga, “Omuseege omurikyaazo kyeego wiiseegiri omweene.”
Nawe kyeego mukwiiruma no okwiiyirya kye ebhityeenyi, mwiiroreerere okubha mutaaza mukiisikya.
Ambe kino nikubhabhuurira ni kubha, eteemo yeenyu ebhe erakaangatibhwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru. Muraakore ego, mutakutuniirira kweeki enaamba yo omubhiri.

Ndabhabhuurira ego, kwe ekigirirye bhyoosi bhino enaamba yo omubhiri ekwiigoomba, etari kyeego Ekoro Muhoreeru akweenda, na kyeego Ekoro Muhoreeru akweenda, etari kyeego enaamba yo omubhiri ekwiigoomba. Ekoro Muhoreeru ne enaamba yo omubhiri bhirahakana, kwe ekigirirye kiyo mutakweenderwa kukora kyokyoosi kino mukweenda mukore.
Eraabhe murikaangatibhwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru, mutakubha abhabhagati iyaasi we emigiro.
Ambe, amangʼana gano garakorwa kwe esimuka ye enaamba yo omubhiri gwaazo kubhweero, nago ni bhuseebheeti, amakire, okukora amangʼana ge eziisoni,

okuseengera emisaambwa gyo okubhaazwa, obhurogi, obhubhisa, eriiyoge, obhururu, obhwiimani, obhutwaanikani, orurimi, omugono, obhunywi obhuraara, obhusoohu na amangʼana agaandi goosi gano gakutuubhana na gayo. Ndabhabhuurira kweeki kyeego niari nibhabhuuriiri kubha, abhaatu bhano bhakukora amangʼana gayo, bhatakugabha kyokyoosi mubhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya.
Nawe kyeego tukukaangatibhwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru, turabha no omusumo gwaaye nigwo, obhuseegi, obhuzomererwa, omureembe, obhwiikongʼeererya, obhuzomu, obhusaambaaruku, obhuheene,
obhunyoohu na kusuuhu. Gutariho omugiro guno gukurekya omuutu atakora amangʼana gayo.

Abhaatu bhano bhagwaateeni na Krisito Yeesu, obhona bhatakubhaahwa no obhwiikari bhwe esimuka ye ebhibhi, hamwe ne eziinaamba zyaabhu na amiiseego gaabhu mabhiihu. Ni kyeego bhakagituruungazya kumusaraba gwa Yeesu.
Ekoro Muhoreeru atuheeri obhwiikari obhuhya, ambe tutuniirire obhukaangati bhwaaye.
Tutiikumya bhusa, tutiisoka naabhe okurorerana omugono.

footnotes.text: Obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubha ameegyo go orurimi ga abhaatu bhasuuhu, garakaangirirya abhaatu bhaaru.
-21 Obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya ni hagiro hayo hoosi hano Taatabhugya niwe omukaangati. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
